screenRecorder.title: Screen Recorder
screenRecorder.description: Record your screen, window, or tab directly in the browser without installing anything
screenRecorder.readyToRecordDesc: Click the button below to select what to record. You can choose entire screen, specific window, or browser tab.
screenRecorder.permissionDeniedDesc: Please allow screen sharing in your browser settings, or try again.
screenRecorder.notSupportedDesc: Your browser does not support screen recording. Please use a modern browser like Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.

howto.title: How to Use
items: Choose quality, frame rate and audio settings, then start recording.
Select a screen, window or tab. Duplicate starts are blocked during setup, and setup can be canceled.
If the requested microphone cannot connect, choose to continue without it or cancel setup.
Pause or resume while recording. Check connected audio tracks and the current recording time.
Only a new successful recording replaces the last result. Canceled setup or a failed attempt keeps the previous result.
Play the last result and use Download to save it. Results held in memory are lost when you leave the page.

formats.title: Recording Specs
items: Output: supported WebM candidates are checked, and the actual result format and filename are shown.
Requested resolution: 480p, 720p or 1080p. Actual dimensions depend on the shared source and browser.
Requested frame rate: 30 or 60 fps. Actual recording depends on what the source and browser provide.
Audio: requested system or microphone audio is distinguished from tracks connected when recording started.

tips.title: Useful Tips
items: System-audio availability depends on the browser and shared source. Check the connected-track notice and play the result.
Lower quality for longer recordings to save space
WebM files can be played in VLC, browsers, etc.
Disable notifications before recording for cleaner videos

whatIs.title: What is the Screen Recorder?
whatIs.description: A tool that lets you record your screen, a specific window, or a browser tab directly from the browser — no software installation required. It uses the Screen Capture API and supports microphone audio and system audio (tab sound) recording. Perfect for creating online tutorials, capturing bug reproductions, recording work demos, and more.

items.a: The tool checks screen-sharing support and MediaRecorder formats before starting. Screen and audio availability varies by browser, device and source; unsupported environments receive a notice.

items.q: Are recordings saved to a server?
items.a: Recordings are not uploaded to a server. The last successful result is kept in memory for this visit. Use Download to save a needed file. It is replaced by a new valid result or removed by explicit deletion.

items.q: Can I record system audio (video/game sound)?
items.a: Requesting system audio does not guarantee a track. A connected track is shown when the browser and selected source provide one. Play the recording to verify the sound.
